decisions.statement: An icon's keywords have every word its name is split into.
An icon's keywords have every tag and alias and category the icon states.
A shard already standing keeps the identity that shard had.
A shard already there is the index's answer for its page type rather than a folder listed.
A page named like a shard but sitting elsewhere is no shard.
The module page type is reached by the id it keeps rather than by the slug it answers to.
A rendered page imports the type file beside that page type rather than the page type.
A rendered page names that file by its path rather than by a package.
A shard has at least one icon however long that icon's line is.
One icon whose line alone runs past the budget is refused rather than divided.
The entries budget leaves room for what formatting adds and the pascal budget does not.
A body rendered at or past the size a write refuses renders nothing at all.
The page anything outside imports reaches its shards by the path every shard sits at.
That page names each shard from the root rather than by a relative path.
A shard no longer reached is taken away rather than left unimported.
Nothing here writes a file or reaches the network.

definition: a folder of lucide icon metadata read and rendered as the pages a search runs over
